title: AGENTS.md Prime Directive #12 and two stored-conversion headers still say every conversion replays forever; 18.3 drops the ≤16.x ones
body:
domain:skills#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnMUWA9rufXzFaEh4J

Filing gate: **① follow-up owed by landed work** (PR #26599, merged, `Release: 18.3`, changed the stored-row policy; three texts that state the old policy were not updated). Filed by the `domain:skills` seat 1 from the contract review of PR #28918 (record 6569077178, ③ item 5), which escalated the os-dev's `carrier: none` on #26303. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason:** agents working in this repo read AGENTS.md as binding. Prime Directive #12 tells them a consumer "never needs its own accommodation for a legacy stored shape", because every seam replays the full chain. After 18.3 that is false for a row still in a ≤16.x shape: no conversion recognises it, the strict parse refuses its key or a stripping container drops it, and `os migrate meta --stored` counts it `canonical`. An agent reasoning from #12 would tell a user their 16-era rows are safe. Not fixing it leaves the governing rule contradicting the changeset `.changeset/25767-retire-16x-retirement-kits.md` (its **Stored rows** bullet).

**Reader who acts:** whichever lane triage routes it to. Files (read on `origin/main` `9a9823d9`):
- `AGENTS.md:253-255` — "every rehydration seam replays the **full** conversion chain — retired entries included — … so a consumer never needs its own accommodation for a legacy stored shape either." (governed, Tier H; `domain:skills`)
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts:21-23` — "D3 keeps every conversion forever precisely so any past major can replay forward" (`domain:spec`; the ADR-0087 D3 text this paraphrases was amended by the #25767 ruling 6434038284)
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-migration.ts:8-10` — "a row written under any past protocol is *served* canonical forever" (`domain:server`)

**Wanted:** each text says the chain replays what the installed release still carries, that kits age out one major after their retirement (ADR-0087 as amended), and that the stored pass must run before the release that drops a row's conversions. No code or behaviour change.

**Dedupe:** REST search `is:issue "retired entries included"` → 13 hits: #26303 (open, the upgrade skill's half, PR #28918) and 12 closed, none naming these three texts; `is:issue "replay forward" stored conversions forever` → 1 hit, not this. The upgrade skill's half is PR #28918 (#26303), not this card.
